name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: RECONCILE (A) auto-merge-completion observability: an auto-merge GitHub completed asynchronously BETWEEN ticks left no tick-trace confirmation the merge landed — a PR whose issue was already auto-closed by its Closes #<n> keyword left merged=0 forever. FIX (additive, non-breaking): ReconcileResult gains an auto_merged list; Reconcile._reconcile_one, inside the (A) MERGED-PR branch and BEFORE the existing still-open-issue close path, appends {pr_ref, issue_ref} to result.auto_merged UNCONDITIONALLY for every merged acted_ledger PR seen this tick (whether or not the source issue is still open). auto_merged is a pure OBSERVABILITY record: it drives no GitHub write and is INDEPENDENT of closed_issues (a merged PR whose issue is already closed appears in auto_merged but not closed_issues); the existing (A) close path, (B) ladder, and (C) dedup are unchanged. RECONCILE_RESULT_SCHEMA_VERSION 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (additive; auto_merged defaults to [] in to_dict/from_dict so a 1.1.0 result deserializes unchanged); RECONCILE_MANIFEST reads unchanged. Re-anchored the housekeep doc baseline (spec.md 616 -> 647, contract.md unchanged at 57). Cross-feature contract: the field is exactly auto_merged, entries {pr_ref, issue_ref}; scheduling (paired cycle) reads reconcile_result.auto_merged to surface the count and stamp those ledger entries terminal so the completion reports exactly once. PRIOR REASON: RECONCILE (B) conflict-recovery prior-verdict race-breaker: RECONCILE runs FIRST in the route (tick-top), when a just-invalidated loop PR is most likely to still report mergeable=UNKNOWN even after gh_pr_state_source's bounded poll, so the (B) ladder (which required a settled live CONFLICTING) never fired and the conflict lingered. The previous tick's VERIFY, which ran later once mergeability settled, already recorded the hard CONFLICTING. FIX (additive, non-breaking): Reconcile reads a NEW OPTIONAL prior_verdicts slot (the previous tick's VERIFY verdicts, a List of verdict dicts identical in shape to the verdicts slot, seeded by scheduling's make_reconcile from the durable persisted verdicts) added to RECONCILE_MANIFEST reads but read OPTIONALLY (absent/empty => exactly today's live-read-only behavior, so the un-wired route still validates). The (B) conflict determination becomes LIVE-PREFERRED with a prior-verdict race-breaker (Reconcile._is_conflicting): a settled live mergeable is authoritative (MERGEABLE => left alone/never force-pushed, CONFLICTING => ladder), and ONLY on a live UNKNOWN (poll exhausted) does it consult prior_verdicts, treating the PR as CONFLICTING iff the prior verdict for that pr_ref was CONFIRMED-CONFLICTING (a hard mergeable=CONFLICTING, DISTINCT from a transient DEFERRED/UNKNOWN verdict, centralized in the pure _is_confirmed_conflicting_verdict). RECONCILE stays advisory (never raises; per-entry fault -> errors; emits only OK) and trust-gated (mutating recovery only at permits('merge', mode)); (A) merged-PR issue-close and (C) same-issue dedup unchanged. spec.md 0.10.0 landed in a preceding dedicated spec commit (da2af23); this cycle syncs contract.md 0.9.3 -> 0.10.0 + CHANGELOG 0.10.0 and re-anchors the housekeep doc baseline (spec.md 569 -> 616, contract.md 56 -> 57). Cross-feature contract: the shared slot is named exactly prior_verdicts and carries a List of verdict dicts identical in shape to the verdicts slot; scheduling seeds it in a paired cycle.
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md 0.11.0 for the auto_merged (A) observability change landed in the dedicated spec commit d5a15f6 preceding this TDD cycle; this cycle syncs impl + tests + CHANGELOG 0.11.0 + re-anchored housekeep baseline + feature.json 0.14.0.
